profile.summary: As a Computer Science graduate from Rice University with an established interest in full-stack software engineering, I am particularly interested in designing and developing user-driven, scalable applications to effect meaningful impacts on both personal and social scales.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Assembled a Conda package for more convenient deployment of OliVar, a bioinformatics pipeline that aids in designing novel COVID-19 RT-PCT diagnostics assays
Validated OliVar with multiple testing runs and assessed  its performance compared with other similar programs
Improved the output reporting and  visualization layer of OliVar with added graphics
